description: This Java source file defines the IncomingMessage activity for an Android application, providing UI for posting notifications related to incoming messages. It includes methods to create notification intents, display notifications with message details, and handle user interactions through buttons.

classes.name: IncomingMessage
classes.description: An Android activity class that provides UI buttons to trigger notifications mimicking incoming messages and interstitial notifications. It includes methods for constructing message intents and displaying notifications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and attaches click listeners to buttons for posting notifications.

methods.name: makeMessageIntentStack
methods.description: Creates an array of intents forming the back stack for the notification, navigating through app activities to the message view.

methods.name: showAppNotification
methods.description: Builds and posts a notification simulating a message from 'Joe' with random message content.

methods.name: showInterstitialNotification
methods.description: Builds and posts a notification representing an interstitial message from 'Dianne'.
